heading: Rule 1 — `linear_scan: false` with `logical: false` implies alpha-only mode
text:
### Rule 1 — `linear_scan: false` with `logical: false` implies alpha-only mode [LCAP.3.1]

`linear_scan: false` requires the identity-slot EQ anchor (LNLS.3.3), which
must be on a `logical`-lifecycle schema on both sides. `logical: false`
forbids logical schemas. Therefore no multi-pattern rule can satisfy
LNLS.3.3, and the LNLS.3.3c error fires for every multi-pattern rule.

**Practical consequence**: a program with both settings may only contain
single-pattern rules.  The beta network is absent; every
operation is an alpha-level operation.
